prerequisites: Basic course in programming Y1 or corresponding information

learning_outcomes.text: independently design and implement an object-oriented program consisting of several classes.
use object-oriented abstractions such as inheritance.
understand the effects of design decisions on the functionality of program and on the program development process, especially on the further development of the code.
justify and document the key design decisions made during the process.
use unit testing in program development.
use tools in an integrated development environment.
know the basics of concurrent programming and how they can be applied in a simple case.
find information from documentation of programming language and libraries, and from net.

syllabus_topics: Basics of object-oriented program design, techniques and methodology
Personal course project (planning, programming, testing, and documenting activities)
